context: 6 Summary and Outlook We investigated the complexity of the intersection problem for finite monoids, showing that the problem is NP-complete for varieties contained in DO and PSPACE-complete for varieties not contained within DS. To obtain a dichotomy result, one needs to investigate the complexity of the problem when monoids from DS \ DO are part of the input. Using techniques similar to those in Section 5, we were able to show that for a subset of this class, the problem remains NP-complete and thus, we conjecture that the problem is NP-complete whenever V ⊆ DS. The fact that DS \ DO have not been studied and understood well enough from a language-theoretic perspective makes the problem of classifying the complexity of these monoids challenging but, at the same time, an interesting object for further research.
